layers.label: Expanded envelope
layers.explanation: The swollen, spread-thin outer gas that makes the giant so huge — and, being spread so thin, cooler than the old photosphere.

layers.label: Hydrogen-burning shell
layers.explanation: A thin rind just outside the inert core where the last hydrogen left burns — the furnace that keeps the star shining in this stage.

layers.label: Inert helium core
layers.explanation: The dead, contracting center — out of hydrogen, not yet hot enough for helium fusion, propped up only by electron pressure.

hotspots.label: Inert helium core
hotspots.description: The dead center. Hydrogen exhausted; nothing fuses here yet — this is what triggered the whole expansion.

hotspots.label: Hydrogen-burning shell
hotspots.description: A thin blazing rind wrapped around the inert core, burning the last hydrogen as a shell.
hotspots.positionHint: Roughly a quarter of the way out from the core

hotspots.label: Expanded envelope
hotspots.description: The spread of gas that ballooned the star to dozens of times its old radius; thin, cool, and red.
hotspots.positionHint: Broad outer region of the giant

hotspots.label: Red photosphere (surface)
hotspots.description: The visible surface, down to about 3,000 K — the redness that names the giant.

hotspots.label: Size comparison — old star inside
hotspots.description: A small yellow-white sphere drawn to the same scale as the star's old main-sequence size, floating beside the giant for scale drama.
hotspots.positionHint: At the side of the model, faintly glowing

visualStyleNotes: Huge soft red-orange sphere with a barely-visible inner ember, matched Anatomy Atelier drift gain: clean shape, gentle gradients, no glare. A small yellow-white main-sequence ball sits beside it for scale. Cross-section toggle reveals the bright shell ring around a dull dark core.
materialNotes: Envelope: translucent red-orange, faint surface speckle. Burning shell: emissive pale gold ring. Inert core: matte dark umber. Use the crossSectionAvailable flag to demonstrate the shell ring in step 2 (Touch it).
assetBrief: Procedural Three.js scene: giant sphere (radius ~3.2 units), small companion sphere (~0.35), shell ring emissive, inert core matte. Cross-section plane deletes one side to show shell. Hotspot bead radius ~0.18, picking consistent with the rest of the stars set.
